description: This file provides graph traversal primitives, including implementations for breadth-first and depth-first traversal algorithms, with methods for walking graphs, tracking visited nodes, and resetting traversal state.

classes.name: BreadthFirst
classes.description: A struct implementing stateful breadth-first graph traversal with customizable edge filtering and visit callbacks.

classes.name: DepthFirst
classes.description: A struct implementing stateful depth-first graph traversal with customizable edge filtering and visit callbacks.

methods.name: Walk
methods.description: Performs a breadth-first traversal starting from a node, following edges based on EdgeFilter, and stopping when 'until' condition is met.

methods.name: WalkAll
methods.description: Performs breadth-first traversal on all nodes in an undirected graph, with optional callbacks before, after, and during traversal.

methods.name: Visited
methods.description: Checks if a node has been visited during traversal.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the traversal state for reuse.

methods.name: Walk
methods.description: Performs a depth-first traversal starting from a node, following edges based on EdgeFilter, and stopping when 'until' condition is met.

methods.name: WalkAll
methods.description: Performs depth-first traversal on all nodes in an undirected graph, with optional callbacks before, after, and during traversal.
